_doc: Per-supplier profile. This mirrors the PROVEN in-app shape (src/services/supplierProfile.js): structure is MEASURED from what past scans actually returned (not guessed), and a correction becomes a hint only after it REPEATS. Thresholds: a supplier is 'ready' after cleanStreak >= 3 (three scans approved untouched); a corrected field becomes an instruction after count >= 2. Hints ride in the USER message on the next scan, never in the cached system prompt.

_derivation.codes: For each line barcode: length>=12 and passes GTIN check digit → full++; length 4-9 and cannot → short++ (this supplier prints the EAN tail). short>full over >=3 codes → 'shortened barcode' hint.
_derivation.corrections: Diff the raw extraction against the human-approved value AFTER putting both through the validator's own normalization (dates→ISO, money→agorot) — otherwise the validator's normalization looks like a human correction and every scan reports false fixes.
_derivation.readiness: new (samples 0) → learning (cleanStreak < 3) → ready (cleanStreak >= 3). One correction resets the streak to 0.
